units: latencies in ms (keys *_ms) and microseconds (keys *_us) per call

method.naive: table and per-call oracle chosen and scored on the same 50-repeat timing means; in_sample: exact-shape table chosen on all calls; held_out: exact-shape table chosen on the other prompt folds with bucket / global fallback (cv_exact_headroom).
method.split_half: cross-fitted split-half: halves A = m + D, B = m - D, D ~ N(0, s^2/n) per call and chunk (exact conditional law of two 25-repeat half-means given the 50-repeat mean under Gaussian repeats); table and oracle chosen on one half, scored on the other, both directions averaged; conservative (lower bound in expectation).
method.split_half_plugin: A, B ~ N(m, 2 s^2/n) independently around the observed means; treats the observed means as truth and keeps part of the selection bias.
method.bootstrap_bias_correction: m* = m + N(0, s^2/n); bias = E[naive(m*)] - naive(m); corrected = naive - bias.
method.null_zero_headroom: truth mu0 = per-shape chunk profile + per-call level (true headroom exactly 0); X0 = mu0 + N(0, s^2/n); naive estimator applied; p = share of draws >= observed.
method.noise_share: split = 1 - split_half/naive (clipped, upper bound); null = null mean / naive (clipped); bootstrap = bias / naive.
